resources.string: The Dom sets the rules; the Sub brings the devotion. Choose Censor, Limits, and tribute rules, then enter service from Home.
Take the reins: choose features, assign apps, and shape your arrangement. Keyholder can guard Dom access with a PIN or authenticator code.
Follow your Dom’s arrangement. Enter Service on Home starts the controls; your chosen service lock governs release.
Keep tempting content under wraps. Cover selected body areas and phrases in assigned apps, or export censored copies of photos and videos.
Playtime has rules. Set daily app allowances; when they run out, SubHub returns the covered app to Home.
A little tribute for a little temptation. Choose which events add to the ledger; connect PayPal before checkout.
Let the Dom keep the keys. Guard Dom access with a PIN, an authenticator code, both, or neither.
The Dom sets a private PIN and enters it on this phone to approve access to their controls.
The Dom adds your setup key to Google Authenticator on their phone. Ask for their current six-digit code to open Dom controls. They do not need SubHub.
Recognize content and enforce app limits in the apps you select. Enable SubHub in Android’s Accessibility settings.
Place censor overlays and effects over other apps.
Show service status, export progress and alerts. Android keeps a notification while a service is running.
